translation_policy: title_en preserves verified English headings with capitalization and line wrapping normalized. title_he is an editorial Hebrew gloss, not official text.
granularity: Principal textbook sections, not every paragraph-level heading. Chapter 18 uses all nine body headings because it has no grouped principal sections.
scope_rules: The official syllabus, not a generated topic list, determines scope. All material in each included full chapter remains required, including introductory text, lower-level headings, figures, examples and boxes; the principal-section list is a navigation aid, not a scope reduction.
Partial Lehninger chapters require the Introduction and only the explicitly listed numbered sections.
Physiology chapters 1, 2, 5 and 6 require all chapter material except the exact official exclusions. Chapter 4 and chapter 12 are include-only lists.
Each subtopic includes all subordinate material in its textbook section, unless excluded in that same area and chapter. Exclusion matching is scoped by area and chapter, never global by keyword.
Sensory Transduction is retained in physiology chapter 5: the official exclusions name Receptive Fields, Coding of Information by Action Potentials and Sensory Coding, not all sensory transduction.
Teach and assess only included scope; do not fabricate lessons, citations, questions or claims of complete exam coverage from headings alone.
Learning requires knowledge, understanding, application and integration between areas. Do not omit plant biology or clinical examples where the included chapters contain them.
Recheck the official syllabus before preparing for the 2027 exam. This file does not establish 2027 scope.
caveats: Physiology detailed TOC comes from third-party reproductions, not a publisher/library-verified detailed TOC. Official includes/exclusions are independently verified in TAU PDF.

TOC structure alone is not sufficient to generate accurate or complete teaching content. Obtain the exact-edition textbooks or verified subject sources, write original explanations and validate all lessons/questions.
Do not treat number of navigation topics as exam weighting, book length or study-hours estimate.

sources.used_for: Included chapters, required introductions/subsections, 15 explicit physiology exclusions, equal weighting and full-chapter scope.
Exact numbered section headings and chapter titles. Authors, year and ISBN verified in repository metadata and edition title page.
Exact chapter and principal section headings. Chapter 18 has no principal section groups, so all nine body headings are retained.
International edition and chapter titles cross-check.
Edition and chapter-level TOC only. Publisher page does not verify detailed section headings.
Detailed section headings. Lower-confidence source than publisher/library; must be checked against a legitimate book copy before claiming content-level completeness.
